text: TGF-beta family ligands signal through receptor serine/threonine kinases that phosphorylate receptor-activated Smad (R-Smad) proteins. R-Smads then partner with the co-Smad ___ before translocating together into the nucleus to regulate gene expression.
explanation: Smad4 is the shared co-Smad that partners with ligand-activated R-Smads (such as Smad1/5/8 for BMP signaling or Smad2/3 for TGF-beta signaling) to form a complex that enters the nucleus and regulates transcription. This pathway is also subject to negative feedback via inhibitory I-Smads (Smad6/7), which compete with R-Smads for receptor interaction.
